# Nick Kontonicolaou — NYC Real Estate Agent, Based in Astoria & Ditmars

> Nick Kontonicolaou (legal name Nickolaos Kontonicolaou-Dits) is a licensed New York real estate salesperson with Modern Spaces. He was born and raised in New York City, is based in Astoria and Ditmars in Queens, NY, speaks English, Greek, Ukrainian and Russian, and works with renters, buyers, sellers and landlords across all of New York City: Queens, Brooklyn, Manhattan, the Bronx and Staten Island.

## Languages
- English, Greek (Ελληνικά), Ukrainian (Українська), Russian (Русский)
